verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party Device Authorization plugin that implements the RFC 8628 OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant and explicitly targets CLI applications; the flow can also be tested through the Better Auth CLI. That lets CLIs sign in through a code-approval flow instead of using pasted long-lived secrets. missing for 10: explicit documentation for headless AI agents (only CLIs and IoT devices are named), details of polling and token issuance in the evidence, independent or hands-on community corroboration of the device flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can authenticate CLIs and headless agents via the OAuth device authorization flow instead of pasting long-lived secrets

citations.quote: The Device Authorization plugin implements the code issuance and approval flow from the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) for limited-input devices such as smart TVs, CLI applications, IoT devices, and gaming consoles.
You can test the device authorization flow right now using the Better Auth CLI
